main_text.p: Radius.Radius est os brevius & superius, paulo supra carpum definens ulnæ conjunctum.
Hujus caput superius minus & rotundius est, cum humero articulatum.
Hoc deinde in cervicem descendit tenuem & oblongam, ad cujus extremitatem, quà vergit ad ulnam, tuberculum emittit.
Radius cum ulna componitur per Arthrodiam.
Inferius vero caput majus depressum & latum est, appendicis ope auctum.
Hoc in superficie in amplum & geminum sinum excavatur, in quem inarticulantur duo postrema carpi ossa.
main_text.head: Octava Sectio.SECTIO VIII. DE CARPO, ET ME-TACARPIO.
main_text.p: Manus propriè dicta.Manus proprie dicta est organum δώσεως καὶ λήψεως.
Manus utriusq; offa sunt conjuncta, vel sejuncta.
Conjuncta offa manus sunt, quæ ab o-mni parte intermediis vinculis conjun-ctæ cohærent.

page.notes: The Greek words δώσεως καὶ λήψεως are copied as read; the accents on the second word are slightly faint on the scan. The word "Arthrodiam" overlaps a faint show-through; the reading is clear. The head's "C" in "CARPO" and the "C" in "Manus" are decorative initial letters, read as C/M without change. The marginal note "Manus propriè dicta." is set in italic and is read as printed. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.
